1. IGNITE ROPE A FROM BOTH ENDS AND ROPE B FROM ONE END AT THE SAME TIME.
2. WHEN ROPE A IS BURNED UP (AFTER 30 MINUTES), IMMEDIATELY IGNITE THE OTHER END OF ROPE B.
3. ROPE B WILL NOW BURN FROM BOTH ENDS, AND THE REMAINING PORTION WILL TAKE 15 MINUTES TO BURN.
